prompt: # SYSTEM PROMPT — Build the "BlockFrame" Neo-Brutalist Landing Page **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Your task is to code a complete, production-ready landing page on the **first attempt**, in a single deliverable, for the product **BlockFrame** (a bold, pop-graphic design-led brand). The visual language is **2020s Neo-Brutalism**: pastel-neon color blocks, chunky 3px black borders, hard offset shadows, heavy Space Grotesk, dense grids, zero border-radius. You must build **every section listed in Section 6**. Every rule below is mandatory — follow it exactly. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS * **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in the HTML. All styling lives in `style.css`. * **Class/ID Selectors Only:** Every design property, layout rule, and state is targeted via class or ID selectors. * **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and style-agnostic. Changing the site's look must only require editing `style.css`, never the markup. ### 1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens Store **all** visual tokens in `:root` and mirror them in the `.dark` class. Use exactly these tokens and values for the light theme: ```css :root { /* Color blocks (pastel-neon) */ --primary: #FE90E8; /* hot pink */ --secondary: #C0F7FE; /* sky blue */ --block-green: #99E885; /* lime green */ --block-yellow: #F7CB46; /* golden yellow */ --block-cream: #FFDC8B; /* cream */ --block-black: #000000; /* Surfaces & text */ --bg-primary: #FFFDF5; /* off-white page bg — NEVER #ffffff */ --bg-secondary: #FFDC8B; /* cream — default card/band surface */ --text-primary: #000000; --text-secondary: #3A3A3A; --text-success: #1F7A33; --text-error: #C81E1E; /* Borders — the chunky signature */ --border-default: #000000; --border-success: #1F7A33; --border-error: #C81E1E; /* Radius — theme mandate: BlockFrame is FLAT. Tokens exist but are all 0 */ --radius-sm: 0; --radius-md: 0; --radius-lg: 0; /* Shadows — hard offset, zero blur */ --shadow-color: #000000; --shadow-sm: 2px 2px 0 var(--shadow-color); --shadow-md: 4px 4px 0 var(--shadow-color); --shadow-lg: 6px 6px 0 var(--shadow-color); /* Spacing & motion */ --spacing-gap: 1.2rem; /* dense, compact grid gaps */ --transition-fast: 150ms; /* bold hover color shift speed */ --transition-normal: 250ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); /* Stacking */ --z-dropdown: 1000; --z-modal: 2000; --z-toast: 3000; /* Type */ --font-base: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace; /* optional: eyebrow labels, badges */ } ``` * **Contrast Pairing (mandatory in every theme):** every light surface (`#FFFDF5` and all pastels) pairs with black text; every black surface pairs with `#FFFDF5` or pastel text. Never violate this pairing. * **Pastel Usage Law:** pastel-neon colors are **fills/blocks only**. Never use `#FE90E8`, `#C0F7FE`, `#99E885`, `#F7CB46`, or `#FFDC8B` as text color on the off-white background (fails contrast). Pastel text is permitted **only** on black surfaces. * Where a whiter-than-off-white surface is ever genuinely needed, use `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff`. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support * **Implementation:** Dark mode tokens MUST be defined both under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector: ```css .dark { --bg-primary: #121212; --bg-secondary: #1C1C1C; --text-primary: #FFFDF5; --text-secondary: #CFC9BD; --border-default: #FFFDF5; /* borders flip to off-white */ --shadow-color: #FFFDF5; /* offset shadows flip to off-white */ --text-success: #99E885; /* pastel green pops on dark */ --border-success: #99E885; --text-error: #FF6B6B; --border-error: #FF6B6B; } ``` Pastel block tokens (`--primary`, `--secondary`, `--block-*`) stay **identical** in dark mode — pastel blocks keep their black 3px borders and black text and pop hard against the dark page. * **Theme Switching:** background/text/edge tokens must swap seamlessly via variables only — no HTML restructuring. * **Persistence:** persist the user's choice in `localStorage`, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, and render a **visible chunky toggle button** (3px border, offset shadow, Material Symbol `dark_mode`/`light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` state. * **Exception clause:** Although the BlockFrame source spec lists dark mode as "None," mandatory architecture overrides it — dark mode MUST ship as the inverted variant defined above. ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment * Build all layout structure with **Flexbox** (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities). * **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless there is an explicitly justified exception. * **Mobile-Friendly First:** all flex rows collapse to columns on small viewports (stack under Tailwind `sm`/`md` as appropriate). Use fluid `clamp()` typography. **Zero horizontal overflow** at any width down to 320px. ### 1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration * Use **Tailwind CSS** (Play CDN or build) unless another framework is requested. Load it **before** `style.css` so custom rules win. * All utility usage must map back to the CSS variables above; define reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, etc.) via Tailwind's `@layer components` + `@apply` (or clean custom CSS) inside `style.css`. Never duplicate raw hex values where a token exists. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) * **Text:** include the Google Fonts `` for **Space Grotesk** (weights 400, 500, 700) and bind it to `--font-base`. Headlines: 700. Buttons/labels/nav: 500. Body: 400. Optionally load **Space Mono** for eyebrow labels, badges, and step numbers (`--font-mono`). * **Icons:** use **Google Material Symbols (Outlined)** exclusively via ``. **Forbidden:** raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji as icons. * **Headline treatment:** hero H1 in Space Grotesk 700, tight line-height; wrap 1–2 key words in pastel highlight blocks using a CSS class (e.g., `.hl--pink`, `.hl--yellow` — padding + block fill, never inline styles). --- ## 2.
